sections.title: What to expect at your first visit

faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.lede: Have questions? You're not alone. Here are answers to the things patients ask us most — from appointments and technology to insurance and comfort.

sections.title: General practice
sections.body:
### Do you accept new patients?
Yes! We'd love to welcome you. You can schedule online or call/text our team.

### What should I expect at my first visit?
Your appointment includes digital imaging, a comprehensive exam, a gentle cleaning (when appropriate), and time with your doctor to review your oral health and ask questions.

### How often should I come in for cleanings?
Most patients benefit from visits every six months, though your dentist may recommend more frequent care depending on your needs.

### Do you see children?
Yes — we provide family dentistry and welcome patients of all ages.

sections.title: Comfort and technology
sections.body:
### Does laser dentistry hurt?
Most patients report little to no discomfort. Lasers allow for gentler treatment with reduced vibration and sensitivity.

### Will I need numbing for my appointment?
Often, no. With laser technology and gentle techniques, many procedures can be completed with minimal or no anesthesia.

### I'm anxious about dental visits. Can you help?
Absolutely. Our office is designed to feel calm and welcoming, and our technology allows for a gentler experience that reduces many common anxiety triggers.

### Why is laser dentistry in your name?
We are a comprehensive dental practice — laser dentistry simply reflects our elevated standard of care. It allows for more comfortable, precise treatments.

sections.title: Payment and insurance
sections.body:
### Do you take my insurance?
We work with many insurance plans and help you understand your benefits clearly. Contact us and we'll verify your coverage.

### Do you offer payment plans?
Yes — we offer flexible payment options and a membership plan for patients without insurance.

### How much will my treatment cost?
Costs vary depending on your personalized treatment plan. We provide clear estimates before any care begins so there are no surprises.

sections.title: Treatment
sections.body:
### Do you offer same-day crowns?
Yes — with CEREC technology, we can design, mill, and place a custom ceramic crown in a single visit.

### Do you place dental implants?
Yes, we offer implant placement and restoration with advanced technology and decades of combined experience.

### How long does Invisalign take?
Most patients complete treatment in 6–18 months, depending on alignment needs. You'll receive a personalized estimate at your consultation.

### Do I need x-rays at every visit?
Digital imaging is essential for accurate diagnosis. We follow safe, evidence-based guidelines to determine when x-rays are needed.

sections.title: Appointments and logistics
sections.body:
### How far in advance should I schedule?
We recommend booking routine visits 6 months ahead. For restorative or cosmetic care, availability may vary — contact us for options.

### What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
No problem — we simply ask for as much notice as possible so we can offer the time to another patient.

### Where are you located?
We're conveniently located in Franklin, TN.

sections.body: At Tennessee Center for Laser Dentistry, you're cared for by a team of experienced clinicians dedicated to providing exceptional results and a supportive experience. Each doctor brings unique strengths — and a shared commitment to comfort, innovation, and personalized care.

sections.title: Dr. Chad O. Edwards, DDS
sections.body:
*Founder · Advanced laser dentistry expert · Restorative and implant dentistry*

Dr. Chad Edwards is known for his advanced clinical skill, commitment to innovation, and passion for delivering dentistry at the highest standard. As the founder of Tennessee Center for Laser Dentistry, he has shaped the practice with a philosophy built on better science and better service — offering modern, comfortable, and highly precise care to every patient.

Dr. Edwards has extensive training in laser dentistry and restorative techniques, allowing him to perform many procedures with greater comfort and improved healing. His expertise also includes implant dentistry, full-mouth rehabilitation, cosmetic services, and advanced restorative care.

He is deeply committed to continued education, both as a lifelong learner and as an educator. Dr. Edwards regularly participates in professional training programs and teaches other dentists across the country in the use of laser technology — helping elevate the standard of care far beyond his own practice.

**Outside the office:** Dr. Edwards enjoys spending time with his family, staying active, and staying involved in dental education initiatives that advance the profession.

sections.title: Dr. Ryan R. Torti, DDS
sections.body:
*Restorative and cosmetic dentist · Advanced laser provider · Patient comfort advocate*

Dr. Ryan Torti brings a thoughtful, patient-centered approach to dentistry, blending advanced clinical training with a deep commitment to comfort and communication. Known for his calm, reassuring presence and meticulous attention to detail, Dr. Torti helps patients feel confident and cared for at every step of their treatment.

His areas of expertise include cosmetic dentistry, restorative treatments, Invisalign, and advanced laser dentistry. Dr. Torti's gentle approach — paired with his proficiency in modern technology — allows many patients to receive treatment with minimal or no anesthesia, reduced discomfort, and faster healing.

Dr. Torti is passionate about delivering results that look beautiful, function naturally, and support long-term oral health. He believes every patient deserves clarity in their dental care and enjoys educating patients so they feel empowered in their health decisions.

**Outside the office:** Dr. Torti enjoys spending time with family, teaching, traveling, and staying connected within the Franklin community.

sections.title: Dr. Andy Burton, DDS
sections.body:
*Implant dentistry specialist · Cosmetic and general dentist · Fellow, World Clinical Laser Institute*

Dr. Andy Burton brings more than 30 years of experience in implant dentistry to Tennessee Center for Laser Dentistry, offering patients exceptional expertise in surgical placement, restorative design, and long-term implant success. His depth of clinical knowledge and commitment to precision allow him to deliver results that are both functional and beautifully natural.

A respected clinician in the Nashville region, Dr. Burton is known for his calm demeanor, meticulous approach, and dedication to providing each patient with clear communication and a comfortable experience. His broad skillset spans general, cosmetic, restorative, and implant dentistry, strengthened by ongoing training in emerging technologies and advanced techniques.

Dr. Burton is an active member of multiple professional organizations, including the Nashville Dental Society, the Tennessee Dental Association, the American Dental Association, the Tennessee Academy of Cosmetic Dentistry, the Academy of General Dentistry, and the Academy of Clear Aligners. He is also a Fellow in the World Clinical Laser Institute, reflecting his advanced proficiency in modern laser technology — an essential part of TNCLD's commitment to better science and better service.

**Outside the office:** Dr. Burton enjoys spending time with family, staying active in the dental community, and pursuing continued education that supports his passion for excellence in patient care.

sections.title: Types of cosmetic treatment
sections.body:
### Professional teeth whitening

Brighten your smile with safe, effective whitening options tailored to your sensitivity and desired results.

Thin, custom-crafted shells that transform the shape, color, and symmetry of your smile.

A fast, conservative solution for chips, gaps, and uneven edges.

Full aesthetic transformations combining multiple treatments for the most comprehensive results.

sections.title: Our process: your path to a confident, beautiful smile
sections.body:
Experience cosmetic dentistry designed around your goals and comfort.

### Cosmetic consultation and evaluation

We discuss your goals, evaluate your smile, and determine the best treatment options.

### Personalized aesthetic plan

Using digital imaging and careful planning, we design a custom treatment roadmap aligned with your desired outcome.

Your final treatment delivers a beautiful, confident smile crafted with precision, artistry, and high-quality materials.

sections.title: What to expect
sections.body:
Cosmetic treatment time and investment vary by your goals and the complexity of your plan.

### Treatment duration

Whitening can be completed in one visit; veneers and makeovers require multiple appointments; Invisalign varies from months to a year+ depending on alignment needs.

### Results

Many cosmetic improvements offer immediate or rapid results with proper care.

### Cost

Cosmetic services typically start at a base investment and vary based on treatment type and individual customization. We provide clear pricing, review your insurance coverage where applicable, and offer flexible payment options.

sections.title: Aesthetic expertise. Advanced technology. Beautifully natural results.
sections.body:

Patients trust TNCLD because we offer doctors with advanced training in cosmetic design and alignment, treatment plans grounded in both aesthetics and functional health, digital imaging for accuracy and predictable outcomes, high-quality materials and modern techniques, a supportive patient-centered experience, and over 1,000 five-star reviews for exceptional results.

Yes — many patients choose a smile makeover for a comprehensive transformation.

Most cosmetic treatments are elective, but we'll review your benefits to see if any portion may apply.

dental-implants.lede: Restore your smile with the most advanced, natural-looking tooth replacement option. Our implant expertise and modern technology ensure exceptional results designed to last.

sections.title: A permanent, natural-looking solution for missing teeth
sections.body: Dental implants replace missing teeth with unmatched stability, function, and aesthetics. Whether you're missing one tooth or several, implants restore your ability to chew comfortably, speak confidently, and smile without hesitation — all while preserving long-term oral health.

sections.title: You deserve implant treatment that feels comfortable, clear, and trustworthy
sections.body:
Many patients delay implants because of uncertainty or fear. We address every concern with clarity and expert care.

### Gentle, modern dentistry

Advanced techniques and technology for precise, comfortable treatment.

### Clear, upfront pricing

We provide estimated ranges and review your insurance before treatment begins. No surprises — just transparent, straightforward guidance.

### Expert care you can trust

Doctors with extensive implant training and hundreds of successful cases.

sections.title: Benefits of dental implants
sections.body:
- Look, feel, and function like natural teeth
- Long-term durability and stability
- Preserve bone and facial structure
- Improve confidence and quality of life
- No slipping or adhesives
- Support a healthier smile for decades

sections.title: Solutions tailored to your needs
sections.body:
### Single dental implants

Replace individual missing teeth with long-lasting, natural results.

### Multiple implants

Restore several teeth with stable, functional solutions.

### Implant-supported bridges

A stronger, more durable alternative to traditional bridges.

### Full-arch hybrid solutions

Secure, life-changing full-arch restorations for patients needing complete smile transformation.

sections.title: Your implant journey with TNCLD
sections.body:
Experience implant care designed around your comfort and long-term success.

### Comprehensive evaluation

We use advanced digital imaging to assess your dental structure and create a precise, personalized treatment plan.

### Expert implant placement

Your implant is placed with accuracy and care, supported by modern technology that enhances comfort and healing.

### Custom restoration

A beautifully crafted crown or full-arch solution completes your new smile with natural aesthetics and long-term strength.

sections.title: What to expect
sections.body:
Treatment time and pricing vary depending on your personalized plan.

### Treatment duration

No — it's quick, gentle, and completely non-invasive.

### Do I need screening if I don't smoke?

### Will insurance cover screening?

Many plans provide partial or full coverage. We help verify your benefits.

same-day-crowns-cerec.title: Custom, high-quality crowns completed in one visit
same-day-crowns-cerec.lede: Our advanced CEREC technology allows us to design, craft, and place beautiful ceramic crowns in a single appointment — with exceptional precision and comfort.

sections.title: Strong, natural-looking crowns without the wait
sections.body: Same-day crowns offer the perfect combination of convenience, precision, and aesthetic excellence. Using digital scanning and in-office ceramic milling, we restore damaged or worn teeth in a single visit — no messy impressions, temporary crowns, or second appointments required.

sections.title: A faster, more comfortable way to restore your tooth
sections.body:
We use CEREC technology to eliminate the most inconvenient and uncomfortable parts of getting a crown.

### Gentle, modern dentistry

Digital impressions replace messy putty trays, and same-day completion means no temporary crown discomfort.

### Clear, upfront pricing

We provide estimated ranges and review your insurance before treatment begins. No surprises — just transparent, straightforward guidance.

### Efficient, convenient appointments

One visit replaces the traditional two-appointment process, saving you time and hassle.

sections.title: Benefits of same-day crowns
sections.body:
- Completed in one visit
- No temporary crowns
- Digital impressions for greater comfort
- High-strength ceramic materials
- Natural-looking, custom color matching
- Precise fit for long-term function
- Saves time and reduces treatment visits

sections.title: Types of same-day restorations
sections.body:
### Single CEREC crowns

Ideal for damaged, fractured, or heavily restored teeth requiring full coverage.

### CEREC onlays and inlays

Conservative, durable alternatives when a full crown isn't needed.

### CEREC for emergency restorations

Same-day solutions for sudden breakage or discomfort requiring immediate attention.

### Aesthetic ceramic restorations

Beautiful, tooth-colored restorations that blend seamlessly with your natural smile.

sections.title: Our process: your path to a strong, beautiful restoration
sections.body:
Experience the convenience of same-day crown technology with our streamlined approach.

### Digital scan

We capture a detailed 3D image of your tooth — quickly and comfortably.

### Custom design

Using advanced software, we design your crown for optimal fit, function, and aesthetics.

### In-office fabrication and placement

Your crown is crafted from durable ceramic and placed the same day.

sections.title: What to expect
sections.body:
Same-day crowns streamline the traditional restorative process while maintaining exceptional quality.

### Time

Most appointments take 1–2 hours from start to finish.

### Healing

Minimal downtime — most patients resume normal activities immediately.

### Cost

Same-day crowns typically start at a base investment, with total cost depending on tooth location and complexity. We review pricing and payment options before beginning.

sections.title: Advanced technology. Skilled craftsmanship. Superior results.
sections.body:
CEREC technology is only as effective as the team using it. TNCLD's doctors combine advanced training, restorative expertise, and an eye for aesthetics to deliver crowns that look beautiful and feel natural.

Patients choose TNCLD because we offer expertise in digital and ceramic restorative design, in-office CEREC milling for instant, customized results, and high-quality ceramic materials that last.

We don't just provide faster crowns — we provide better, more precise, beautifully crafted crowns.

sections.title: Patient testimonials
sections.body:
> "I couldn't believe my crown was finished the same day. It looks exactly like my natural tooth and the process was incredibly smooth."

> "No impressions, no temporaries, no second appointment — the technology and the team made everything easy."

> "The CEREC crown matches my other teeth perfectly. I'm so glad I didn't have to wait weeks for a lab."

sections.title: Frequently asked questions
sections.body:
### How long do same-day crowns last?

With proper care, CEREC crowns can last as long as traditional crowns — often 10–15 years or more.

### Are same-day crowns as strong as lab-made crowns?

Yes. The ceramic materials used are highly durable and ideal for long-term function.

### Does insurance cover same-day crowns?

Most plans cover crowns. We'll help verify coverage and discuss payment options.
